typography.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Weights: 400, 500) - highly legible, clear
rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings larger than text-2xl.
Uppercase with tracking-widest for overlines, labels, and badges.

buttons.style: pill-shaped (rounded-full), sharp high-contrast. Primary buttons are bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white. Accent/destructive buttons are bg-[#FF3B30].
buttons.interactions: Hover states must include a slight scale down (active:scale-95) and opacity shift.

cards.style: Minimalist, no heavy drop shadows. Use border border-zinc-200/border bg-white rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl.

inputs.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or large soft-rounded rectangles. border-zinc-200 focus:border-[#0A0A0A] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A0A0A].

badges.style: Priority badge should be highly visible: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider.

layouts.Admin_Dashboard: Bento-grid desktop layout. Large QR code card spanning multiple rows. Clear 'Create Party' button. Minimalist list of past/active parties.
layouts.Admin_Party_Control: Split-screen desktop view. Left column (sticky): YouTube player embedded, current track info overlay, massive playback controls. Right column (scrollable): Live Queue. Priority tracks visually separated or pinned to the top of the 'upcoming' section.
layouts.Guest_Mobile_View: Mobile-first layout. Sticky bottom navigation or sticky top search bar. Full-bleed lists for search results and queue. Large touch targets for adding tracks to the queue. Modal/Drawer for 'Add with Priority' confirmation.

rules: Use spring animations (framer-motion) for adding to queue (slide up/in).
Micro-interactions on all buttons (scale down on press).
Smooth list transitions when queue reorders.

screens.name: Admin Login & Dashboard
screens.description: A pristine, airy page with a subtle abstract light background. A central glass-like or solid white card for login. Once logged in, a Bento grid showing the Active Party (with a massive, scannable QR code), quick actions, and recent history. High contrast typography.

screens.name: Admin Party Control View (Host Player)
screens.description: Desktop-optimized. The left half is dedicated to 'Now Playing'—featuring a customized overlay over the YouTube iframe to hide default YT controls where possible, showing a clean progress bar, large play/pause/skip buttons, and a prominent QR code in the corner. The right half is a clean, vertically scrolling list of the Queue. Priority items have a distinct red dot or red border.

screens.name: Guest Join Page
screens.description: Mobile-optimized. Ultra-minimalist. A simple greeting, a large text input for 'Your Name', and a chunky pill-shaped 'Join Party' button at the bottom of the screen. Background is pure white.

screens.name: Guest Search & Queue View
screens.description: Mobile-optimized. A floating, pill-shaped search bar at the top with a subtle shadow. Below it, tabs for 'Search' and 'Queue'. Search results are dense but clean list items with square album art, title, artist, and a '+' button. Clicking '+' opens a sleek bottom drawer asking 'Standard or Priority Add?'. The Queue tab shows the live playing song frozen at the top, and the upcoming tracks scrolling below.

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Focus rings visible on keyboard navigation.

images.description: Party crowd with golden concert lights
images.category: Guest Join or Party Active State Hero Cover

libraries.motion: framer-motion for queue reordering and bottom sheets.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Outfit for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body. Add these via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the UI using a very light, high-contrast minimal aesthetic. Do NOT use heavy shadows, prefer 1px borders (border-zinc-200) and flat surfaces.
For the Guest View, ensure it looks and feels like a native mobile app (use h-screen, fixed bottom nav or top sticky search, avoid desktop-like sidebars).
For the Host View, leverage a split-screen or 2-column layout to make use of desktop space.
Priority items must clearly stand out using the accent color (#FF3B30).
Use Lucide-react for all icons. Ensure icons are appropriately sized (w-5 h-5 or similar).
All buttons must have a data-testid. Examples: data-testid='guest-join-button', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='add-to-queue-btn'.
Add transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease for interactive elements. DO NOT use transition: all.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
You have .js files not .tsx files, so write all React components using JSX in .js files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or install if missing.
